params.prompt: Wide shot: the camera is far back and static, the standing character is small and placed in the lower half of the frame, with a large empty area above the head so that even at the top of the jump the whole body stays inside the frame. The character in <Picture 1> performs one standing vertical jump straight up in place, seen in strict side view (profile), facing left. Sequence: stands still for a moment; anticipation crouch (knees bend deeply, the backward-bending hocks compress, arms swing back); explosive takeoff (legs extend, arms swing up, the blade feet leave the ground); airborne at the top of the jump with the legs slightly tucked; landing on both blade feet with the hocks and knees compressing to absorb the impact; recovers back to a relaxed standing pose and stands still. The character does not move forward or backward and does not turn. Smooth, sharp motion without blur. Keep exactly the same character design: chainmail mesh hood over a pale face, dark rust-stained armoured torso, black box backpack, wide boxy rust-orange armoured thigh plates down to the knee, and DIGITIGRADE mechanical legs: thin dark shins that slant backward from the knee to a raised hock, and feet made of three long curved blade tines forming a backward hook whose tips touch the ground. Plain neutral grey seamless studio background, even soft studio lighting, realistic 3D render, no other objects, no text.
